events.title: Richard Fitzalan's English fleet attacks a wine fleet at Margate
events.description: During the Caroline War phase of the Hundred Years' War, an English fleet under Richard Fitzalan, Earl of Arundel, attacked a wine fleet of 250 to 360 French, Flemish and Castilian vessels. The battle continued into the next day.
events.html: During the Caroline War phase of the Hundred Years' War, an English fleet under Richard Fitzalan, Earl of Arundel, attacked a wine fleet of 250 to 360 French, Flemish and Castilian vessels. The battle continued into the next day.

events.title: Timur sacks Damascus
events.description: The Central Asian conqueror's army plundered and burned Damascus after its surrender, and its craftsmen were carried off to Samarkand. The Mamluk Sultanate survived, but Syria was devastated.

events.title: Elizabeth I dies and James VI of Scotland inherits England
events.description: Elizabeth died at Richmond Palace, and her cousin James VI became James I of England and Ireland. The crowns were united, though the kingdoms stayed separate until 1707.
events.html: Elizabeth died at Richmond Palace, and her cousin James VI became James I of England and Ireland. The crowns were united, though the kingdoms stayed separate until 1707.

events.title: Parliament passes the Quartering Act
events.description: The act required American colonies to provide barracks and supplies for British troops. Resentment of it was later listed among the grievances in the Declaration of Independence.
events.html: The act required American colonies to provide barracks and supplies for British troops. Resentment of it was later listed among the grievances in the Declaration of Independence.

events.title: Tadeusz Kościuszko proclaims a general uprising in Kraków
events.description: In Kraków, Tadeusz Kościuszko proclaimed a general uprising against Russia and Prussia and took command of all Polish forces. His speech is considered the start of the Kościuszko Uprising, whose defeat led to the Third Partition of 1795.

events.title: Robert Koch identifies the tuberculosis bacterium
events.description: In a lecture in Berlin, Koch showed that tuberculosis, then causing about one in seven deaths in Europe, was caused by a bacterium. 24 March is now World Tuberculosis Day.

events.title: Allied prisoners break out in the 'Great Escape'
events.description: That night 76 airmen crawled through a tunnel out of Stalag Luft III in Sagan. Only three reached safety; on Hitler's orders, 50 of those recaptured were shot.
events.html: That night 76 airmen crawled through a tunnel out of Stalag Luft III in Sagan. Only three reached safety; on Hitler's orders, 50 of those recaptured were shot.

events.title: Military coup overthrows Isabel Perón in Argentina
events.description: A junta led by General Jorge Videla took power and began the 'Dirty War'. Thousands of people, estimated at up to 30,000, were 'disappeared' before military rule ended in 1983.
